meta.title: User Agreement - Soff.uz
meta.description: User agreement of the Soff.uz platform. Terms and conditions for using the digital products and online services marketplace.

intro.p1: This User Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "Agreement") is concluded between the Soff.uz platform (hereinafter referred to as "Platform") and the user of the Platform services and establishes the terms and conditions for using the https://soff.uz website and the seller.soff.uz sellers panel.
intro.p2: Please read the Agreement carefully before using the Platform. If you do not agree with any provision of the Agreement, you may refuse to use the Platform.

section1.title: 1. Basic Concepts
section1.p1: Platform — Soff.uz website and related services, a marketplace that allows selling and buying digital products (business plans, information, manuals, abstracts, presentations, etc.) and online services.
section1.p2: Personal account — A special page created by a User or Seller on the Platform, intended for using services.
section1.p3: "SOFF-STUDY" LLC — "SOFF-STUDY" Limited Liability Company (TIN: 309460545). Legal address: Republic of Uzbekistan, Tashkent city, Chilanzar district, Novza mahalla, E quarter, 8/1.
section1.p4: Digital product — Materials and content in electronic format sold on the Platform, including: academic works (business plans, course works, diploma works, abstracts, research, presentations), 3D models and interior designs, design templates (web design, animation, branding, illustration, product design), websites, ready-made templates (business, marketing, financial, educational, legal templates), video tutorials and other digital content. Digital products are downloaded as electronic files and can be used by the user for personal or commercial purposes.
section1.p5: Online service — Remote services offered in the "Business Services" section of the Platform, including: academic and research services (writing scientific articles, conducting research, preparing abstracts, writing course and diploma works), design services (logo design, web design, graphic design, branding), 3D model creation and interior design services, programming services (creating websites, developing mobile applications, writing software) and other remote professional services. Online services are provided by the Seller remotely and are delivered based on pre-agreed terms and deadlines with the User.
section1.p6: User (Buyer) — A person registered as a user on the Platform for the purpose of purchasing digital products or services.
section1.p7: Seller — An individual entrepreneur, legal entity, or self-employed person registered and verified on the Platform to sell their digital products or services.
section1.p8: Order — A formal request made by the User on the Platform to purchase a digital product or service.
section1.p9: Fraudulent activities — Actions committed for malicious purposes through deception and abuse of trust. These actions are prosecuted in accordance with the Criminal Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

section2.p1: 2.1. The subject of the Agreement is to regulate the relations between the Platform and the User/Seller arising from providing access to the Platform.
section2.p2: 2.2. The User and Seller must fully familiarize themselves with this Agreement before starting to use the Platform. Registration, use of any Platform functions, or simply viewing the Platform means full and unconditional acceptance of the Agreement.
section2.p3: 2.3. Use of the Platform is regulated by this Agreement, as well as the following documents that are an integral part of it: Privacy Policy, Terms of Use (Offer).
section2.p4: 2.4. If the User or Seller does not agree with any provision of the Agreement, they are not entitled to use the Platform.

section5.title: 5. Seller Rights and Obligations
section5.subtitle1: 5.1. The Seller has the following rights:

section6.title: 6. Purchasing Digital Products
section6.p1: 6.1.1. The User has the opportunity to view, select, and purchase digital products available on the Platform.
section6.p2: 6.1.2. When processing an order, the User must carefully check the price, description, and terms of the selected product.
section6.p3: 6.1.3. By clicking the "Payment" button, the User expresses consent to purchase the product.
section6.p4: 6.2.1. Payments on the Platform are made through Click, Payme and other official payment systems.
section6.p5: 6.2.2. Product prices are displayed in national currency — soum.
section6.p6: 6.2.3. After successful payment, the product is placed in the User's personal account.
section6.p7: 6.3.1. After payment is made, the digital product is placed in the "Purchased" section of the User's personal account.
section6.p8: 6.3.2. The User can download the product at any time.
section6.p9: 6.3.3. A notification about the product is sent to the User's email address.

section7.title: 7. Refund Policy
section7.p1: 7.1. Given the nature of digital products, funds are not refunded after payment is made and the product is placed in the personal account.
section7.p2: 7.2. Refund requests are considered in the following cases:
section7.p3: — When technical problems occur when downloading the product;
section7.p4: 7.3. Refund requests are considered by the Platform administration within 3 business days.

section8.title: 8. Copyright
section8.p1: 8.1. The Seller may only sell products that belong to them or are placed with the author's permission.
section8.p2: 8.2. If plagiarism or unauthorized use is detected, the product is removed from the Platform and the Seller's account may be blocked.
section8.p3: 8.3. Complaints about copyright violations are considered within 3 business days.
section8.p4: 8.4. The User may only use purchased products for personal purposes. Reselling products or using them for commercial purposes is prohibited.

section9.title: 9. Ratings and Reviews
section9.p1: 9.1. The User has the right to rate and comment on purchased products.
section9.p2: 9.2. Reviews must meet the following requirements:
section9.p4: — Not contain offensive words and slander;
section9.p6: 9.3. The Platform has the right to remove reviews that do not comply with the rules.
